articles.title: EOS Defense Systems Prepares to Build Slinger Counter-Drone Systems
articles.summary: EOS Defense Systems discusses plans for U.S. production of its Slinger counter-drone system, AI-assisted targeting and adjustable levels of autonomy.

articles.title: Pentagon tells Europeans to cool their rhetoric on Russia, sources say
articles.summary: Pentagon officials have in recent weeks asked several NATO countries to tone down their rhetoric regarding the threat posed by Russia, sources told Reuters.

articles.title: Army CIO, ARCYBER host 2026 Cybersecurity Awareness Forum
articles.summary: The Army Office of the Chief Information Officer and U.S. Army Cyber Command co-hosted the 2026 Army Cybersecurity Awareness Forum from Oct. 28 to 29. The two-day virtual event gathered senior Army leaders and cybersecurity professionals to discuss strategies for addressing emerging cyber threats.

articles.title: Why I Serve: LRMC Dental Laboratory Specialist Turns Craftsmanship into Military Service
articles.summary: Growing up in Lomé, Togo along the coast of Gulf of Guinea, Spc. Koffi Ballogou could not have known that his path would eventually lead him to serve in the U.S. Army.

articles.title: USNMRTC/USNH Yokosuka Participate in CFAY-Led Keen Sword Exercise
articles.summary: YOKOSUKA, Japan — Commander, Fleet Activities Yokosuka (CFAY) led an active shooter response exercise Oct. 27 during Keen Sword 27, with personnel from U.S. Navy Medicine Readiness and Training Command Yokosuka (USNMRTC Yokosuka) and U.S. Naval Hospital Yokosuka (USNH Yokosuka) participating in the installation-wide drill.
